description_short: Steps up the general priority of machines that stay input-starved for days, so trucks serve them sooner, and steps them back to their proto default when they work again. Bounded nudges only (one step at a time, a small band around the proto default, per-machine cooldown, daily cap), under a stateless ownership rule: it only ever adjusts a value its own rule could have produced — anything you set yourself is never fought. Blocked (output-full) and parked (paused/disabled) machines are never touched. Requires QoSCore. Ships disabled; enable it in the mod settings.
display_name: QoS Priority Actuator — starved-machine priority nudges
